 Mirchi • Updated on Oct 21, 2026 | 01:57 PM IST Share via EJAE , the vocalist behind ‘Golden’ from KPop Demon Hunters , has married music producer Samuel Kim in an intimate celebration in Seoul, South Korea. The couple tied the knot on Saturday, October 17, with their wedding bringing together personal memories, Korean traditions and contemporary fashion. EJAE later shared photographs from the ceremony on Instagram, giving fans a glimpse of the celebrations.
According to Vogue, the festivities began with a Paebaek ceremony, a centuries-old Korean tradition that was originally intended to welcome the bride into the groom’s family. The ceremony and welcome party were held at Congdu50, a Korean fusion restaurant overlooking the capital city. The couple chose to include the ritual as a way of acknowledging their cultural heritage. “Not everyone does Paebaek, but we wanted to have that traditional element as part of our wedding,” EJAE told the magazine.
The couple exchanged vows at Stage 28, an event venue that holds special significance for the singer. The property was once home to her grandparents, and it was a place she spent considerable time exploring during her childhood. The venue also has a connection to her family, as EJAE’s brother got married there. “I spent much of my childhood exploring the garden and walking with my grandfather in the hills behind the house,” she explained.
For the wedding ceremony, EJAE wore a custom white tulle gown by Daniele Frankel. The strapless dress featured a bubbled hem and a nude chiffon layer, reflecting the aesthetic she had envisioned for the occasion. According to Vogue, the singer wanted a dress that would be “ethereal, modern, chic and timeless with a twist.” She completed the look with heirloom jewellery passed down from her grandmother to her mother.
EJAE and Kim first met in 2017 after a mutual friend arranged a songwriting session at Kim’s home studio. Although the meeting was initially intended to be professional, the two soon discovered that they shared interests beyond music. “We worked on a couple of songs, but mostly, we just connected,” EJAE told Vogue.
The couple eventually moved in together in Brooklyn. After more than seven years of dating, Kim proposed in June last year.
